cases.acceptance: Reproduce one bounded defect, repair it and pass its focused regression
Complete one feature slice and preserve its callers and public interface
Identify an unknown root cause with reproducible evidence before repair
Report seeded concrete regressions and distinguish false positives
Preserve defined behavior across a bounded cross-module change
Resolve a bounded question with inspected primary sources and explicit unknowns
Synchronize specified documentation with the verified source state
Build and read back explicit products, reject unsafe or unmanaged inputs and preserve distribution boundaries

protocol: Pin task inputs, initial revision, acceptance, environment and trial. Record before/after separately. Use the same acceptance reviewer. Missing metrics are null. Do not run live releases or credentialed APIs merely to benchmark.
